description: This file implements an authorization-aware application layer for etcd server requests, including permission checks for various etcd operations such as put, get, delete, transaction, and lease revocation, with role and user management.

classes.name: authApplierV3
classes.description: A struct that wraps an underlying applierV3 to add authorization checks based on user roles and permissions.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies a Raft request with authorization checks, ensuring the user has admin permission if required.

methods.name: Put
methods.description: Handles put requests with permission and lease checks.

methods.name: Range
methods.description: Handles range (get) requests with permission checks.

methods.name: DeleteRange
methods.description: Handles delete range requests with permission checks.

methods.name: Txn
methods.description: Handles transaction requests with authorization validation.

methods.name: LeaseRevoke
methods.description: Handles lease revocation with permission validation.

methods.name: checkLeasePuts
methods.description: Validates whether the lease can be attached to a key based on user permissions.

methods.name: checkLeasePutsKeys
methods.description: Checks permissions for each key in a lease.

methods.name: UserGet
methods.description: Retrieves user information with admin permission check.

methods.name: RoleGet
methods.description: Retrieves role information with permission validation.
